coverage_notes: The paper reports no controlled comparisons of alternative biological-input representations and no biology-removal, corruption, or text-only dependence tests. It does not describe a distinct pretrained biological encoder or an explicit biological-to-LLM connector beyond the unified BPE tokenizer. The sentence-splitting model is not given a separate name, and vocabulary-extension status and decoding parameters are not reported.
